text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final race of the Classic Triple Crown.
The Umamusume sprinting through their youth...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching from the stands,
there was a single, small shadow.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: What if... I had been able to run...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought she wasn't discouraged in the least.
However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A faint lingering dream that cannot be wiped away.
Shaking it off—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A roar from the soul, echoing out toward her classmates. But—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaaaaaaah!!!!!!
I can't take any more of this!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even before being told, Twin Turbo was already
running at over 200% output.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Goal!!!!
This year's Kikuka-sho has been decided right here--!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I gave it everything... That's right,
I won't let anyone say "if only Teio were here"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While many Umamusume were savoring their deep emotions and memories—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I can't run anymore... Can't run at all...
Ehehehehe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having not just run out of gas, but completely burned through her engine itself, Twin Turbo...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She burned so intensely that not even the drama remained,
left simply lying on the turf.
